import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    costs = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
        if even == odd and i != n - 1:
            costs.append(abs(a[i] - a[i+1]))
    costs.sort()
    ans = 0
    for cost in costs:
        if B >= cost:
            ans += 1
            B -= cost
        else:
            break
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
